observations: Upright chest/freezer style with top lid open (photo 0 shows interior basket/compartment and heavy frost/ice on the inner surfaces).
Brand badge on the front door reads 'Haire' and 'THERMOCOOL' (photo 1).
Front door has a temperature control/indicator area (photo 1).
Rear/side view shows a condenser/fan grille area with a protective wire basket (photo 2).
Interior looks dusty/dirty and appears to have ice buildup (photo 0).
Seller text mentions 'thermocool freezer' and 'five...' (capacity/years unclear).

claims.evidence: No photo shows performance tests (cooling temperature, compressor sound, or thermostat function).

claims.claim: string capacity long lasting freezing for up to five...
claims.evidence: The seller’s statement is truncated ('up to five...'); no photo shows capacity (liters) or any duration rating.

risks.risk: Not currently cooling properly (ice/frost pattern could be from prior use, but photos cannot confirm temperature or compressor health).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the freezer running for 10–15 minutes with a thermometer reading inside (and the thermostat set), plus a photo of the compressor/fan area while running.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to be working (worst case: needs service).

risks.risk: Heavy ice buildup/dirty interior suggests it may need defrosting and cleaning; could indicate poor airflow or thermostat issues.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the evaporator/inside after defrost (or a video showing it has been defrosted recently).
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing cleaning/defrost and possible minor faults.

risks.risk: Possible damage/leak or worn seals (door seal condition not clearly shown; frost/ice can also come from air leaks).
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the full door gasket/seal around all edges and a simple test: close the door on a strip of paper and show whether it pulls out easily.
risks.if_unproven: Price as seal condition unknown (worst case: may leak cold).

risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the control knob/label and a video showing temperature setting changes and indicator response.

proof_requests: Video proof: freezer running with thermostat set, plus an internal thermometer reading after 10–15 minutes.
Close-up photos of the door gasket/seal all around (top, sides, bottom).
Photo/video after defrosting (interior clean and ice-free).
Photo of the rating plate/model/serial number (so the exact capacity can be priced correctly).
response.reason: The photos identify it as a ThermoCool upright freezer, but key pricing drivers (exact model/capacity and whether it is cooling correctly) are not verifiable from the images; ice buildup and seal/control condition remain unproven.
